title: Preparation of monovalent follistatin-like 3-Fc-fusion protein and evaluation of its effects on muscle mass in mice
protocol: Grow HEK293T cells in Dulbecco’s modified Eagle medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Culture HEK293T cells in FreeStyle 293 Expression Medium without serum for large-scale culture.
Seed 6 × 10^6 cells in a collagen I-coated T-75 flask.
Prepare solution A by transferring plasmid and envelope/packaging vectors.
Prepare solution B using Lipofectamine 2000.
Incubate solutions A and B for 5 min at 25°C–28°C.
Mix solution A and solution B, then incubate the mixture for 15 min at 25°C–28°C.
Detach cells from flask and resuspend in 10 mL Opti-MEM I supplemented with 10% FBS without antibiotics.
Plate the cell suspension in the collagen I-coated T-75 flask.
Add DNA-Lipofectamine 2000 complex to the cells.
Replace culture medium with 9 mL of DMEM (10% FBS, P/S) on day 2.
Harvest supernatant containing lentivirus on day 4.
Pass harvested supernatant through a 0.22 μm filter.
Transfer filtered supernatant to a 50-mL tube and add 3 mL of cold Lenti-X Concentrator.
Incubate the supernatant with Lenti-X mixture for 1 hour at 4°C.
Centrifuge the mixture at 1500 × g for 45 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend the lentiviral pellet with 1 mL of DMEM (10% FBS, P/S).
Aliquot 200 μL from the viral solution into a 2-mL cryotube.
Store the aliquoted viral solution at -80°C.
Seed 2 × 10^5 HEK293T cells in a 100-mm dish for one infection.
Add 200 μL of virus stock onto the seeded cells.
Replace culture medium with 10 mL of DMEM (10% FBS, P/S) on day 2 after infection.
Refresh the culture medium and supplement with selection antibiotics (1 μg/mL puromycin and/or 100 μg/mL hygromycin B) after day 4.
Allow polyclonal populations to grow for approximately one week.
Harvest cells once they are growing well and expanded sufficiently.
Test harvested cells for protein expression by SDS-PAGE.
Maintain cells in DMEM (10% FBS, P/S).
Passage cells every 2-3 days.
Split HEK293T-mono-FSTL3-Fc cells at ∼80% confluence into 10–11 new 150-mm dishes with 25 mL of DMEM (10% FBS, P/S).
Change medium on day 2-3 after splitting when the cells reach 80% confluence.
Wash cells with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Replace the medium with 25 mL of FreeStyle293 without antibiotics.
Collect the supernatant three days after changing the medium.
Filter the collected supernatant using a 0.22 μm filter system.
Store the filtered supernatant in a –20°C freezer before affinity purification.
Perform all work at 4°C in the cold room from this step forward.
Purify mono-FSTL3-Fc from the supernatant.
Optional: Centrifuge the culture medium if it contains floating cells.
Equilibrate a 1-mL HiTrap column with 10 column volumes of 20 mM sodium phosphate (pH 6.8).
Combine all supernatants from step 11 that contain mono-FSTL3-Fc.
Load the sample into the pre-equilibrated HiTrap Protein A HP column at 1 mL/min using a peristaltic pump.
Wash with over 20 column volumes of 20 mM sodium phosphate (pH 6.8).
Elute the mono-FSTL3-Fc protein using 5 column volumes of 0.1 M sodium citrate (pH 3.5).
Neutralize the eluted protein immediately after elution with 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 9.0) to adjust pH to 7.0–7.4.
Manually elute the protein using a syringe into a new tube containing 100–200 μL of 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 9.0).
Concentrate the pooled fractions from the elution until the volume is reduced to about 1 mL using ultrafiltration.
Replace the solvent with sterile PBS using ultrafiltration by diluting the recombinant protein solution to 15 mL with sterile cold PBS.
Centrifuge at 5,000 rpm (4,032 × g) at 4°C for about 20 minutes until the volume is reduced to approximately 1 mL.
Repeat the solvent replacement process at least three times.
Ensure not to over-concentrate the mono-FSTL3-Fc as it will aggregate above 5 mg/mL.
Aliquot purified recombinant mono-FSTL3-Fc protein in PBS.
Snap freeze the aliquoted samples.
Store the frozen samples at -80°C.
Assess the quality of the proteins by SDS-PAGE.
Determine the concentration of the proteins using anti-human IgG ELISA.
Weigh the animal and calculate the volume to be administered.
Intraperitoneally inject the mono-FSTL3-Fc protein diluted with sterile PBS (10 mg/kg, 0.1–0.5 mL).
Repeat the process twice weekly for 2 weeks (total 4 injections).
Measure mouse body weight.
Euthanize the mouse in accordance with institutional guidelines.
Spray the mouse with 70% ethanol.
Make a small incision in the lower abdomen and pull back the skin.
Carefully separate the gastrocnemius (GC), tibialis anterior (TA), hamstrings (Ham), and quadriceps femoris (QF) muscles, starting from the tendon.
Handle the muscle by the tendon and excise it.
Prepare the sample for cryosectioning.
Cover the muscle in a small amount of FSC 22 frozen section medium.
Cut the muscle at the mid-belly region.
Place the cut surface down on aluminum foil.
Dip the aluminum foil with the muscle into the isopentane/acetone bath for 10–20 seconds.
Embed the frozen muscle into FSC 22 frozen section medium in a tissue-embedding mold, maintaining the same orientation.
Dip the mold with the muscle into the isopentane/acetone bath for 1–2 minutes.
Keep the frozen specimen on dry ice until transferring to a −80°C freezer.
Cut sections 5 μm thick in a cryostat at −20°C.
Transfer the tissue section to a microscope slide by touching the slide to the section at 25°C–28°C.
Air dry the sections using a hair dryer with cool air for 5 minutes.
Fix the sections in 4% PFA/PBS.
Stain the sections with anti-laminin antibody (1:500 dilution).
Obtain images of the section using a fluorescence microscope, such as BZ-X700 microscope.
Quantify the muscle fiber cross-sectional area with image analysis using Hybrid Cell Count software.
